_comment: Racing line optimizer. The line moves only sideways from its seed (track.json racingLineSeed) to minimise curvature, keeping the car (half its width + safetyMarginM) on asphalt plus kerbUse (0..1) of each kerb. shortestBlend > 0 pulls toward the shortest path on gentle sections. Re-run after physics changes (the speed profile depends on grip): npm run optimize-racing-line -- <id> --write, or the editor's Optimize line button.
